2400.name: A Cluttered Beach

north.description: To the north lies The Clearing Before The Forest.

west.description: To the west lies In front of a pier at an island.

2400.description:
A curve of grey shingle is cluttered with the leavings of a hundred
wrecks: split barrels, rope gone stiff as wire, bleached spars and a
ship's lantern with no glass. The waves seem to arrive a long moment
after you see them break. To the west a rickety pier runs out over the
water, and a trodden way leads inland to the north. A cleft in the rocks
at the beach's edge breathes cold air.

2401.name: The Clearing Before The Forest

east.description: To the east lies Entrance Into The Caves.

south.description: To the south lies A Cluttered Beach.

west.description: To the west lies A Well Traveled Path.

2401.description:
The forest draws back here from the beach in a ragged half circle,
leaving a clearing of thin grass and trodden earth. Gulls call from
somewhere above, but their cries reach you a heartbeat late, as if from
far away. A narrow track enters the trees to the west, while the beach
lies to the south. In the east, a dark mouth opens in a bank of rock
overhung with ferns.

2402.name: A Well Traveled Path

east.description: To the east lies The Clearing Before The Forest.

west.description: To the west lies A Clearing In The Path.

2402.description:
The path is well used, a pale ribbon of beaten earth between ferns and
tall straight trees. Every step seems to take a little longer than it
should, and the birdsong in the leaves arrives after the birds have
flown. Cart ruts, long dried, wind off between the trunks. The track
runs east to a clearing by the shore and west on deeper into the forest.

2403.name: A Clearing In The Path

north.description: To the north lies The Endless Path Thru The Forest.

east.description: To the east lies A Well Traveled Path.

2403.description:
A small clearing opens in the path, ringed by old oaks whose roots crawl
across the open ground like sleeping snakes. Shafts of green light fall
at a slant and seem to hang rather than move. A fire ring of blackened
stones holds only damp ash. The track leads east toward a well-trodden
stretch, and a fainter way leaves to the north.

2404.name: The Endless Path Thru The Forest

east.description: To the east lies A Small Crowded Clearing.

south.description: To the south lies A Clearing In The Path.

2404.description:
The path here is endless in the way of a dream: the same trunks, the
same ferns and the same slant of green light, however far you walk. Moss
grows thick on one face of every trunk, though the trees seem to lean
every which way. Your own footfalls come back to you from behind. The
path bends east toward a crowded clearing and south toward the open
space you left.

2405.name: A Small Crowded Clearing

north.description: To the north lies A Rocky Bend In The Trail.

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The Trail.

west.description: To the west lies The Endless Path Thru The Forest.

2405.description:
Brambles and young birches crowd close about this small clearing, so
that the sky is only a rag of grey overhead. A fallen tree lies half
sunk in moss, its bark peeling in long slow curls. A sweet, drowsy smell
hangs in the air and weighs on the eyelids. Paths leave in three
directions: north toward rocks, east along a bend in the trail, and west
the way you came.

2406.name: A Bend In The Trail

north.description: To the north lies The Dark Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Crowded Clearing.

2406.description:
The trail bends sharply round a mossy boulder cracked by a single old
oak growing from the fissure. The air hangs heavy and sweet, and the
drone of unseen insects seems to arrive from a different hour. Mushrooms
ring the stone in pale circles. The trail runs west to the crowded
clearing, and north to a dark tunnel in the hillside.

2407.name: The Dark Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies Entrance To The Hills.

south.description: To the south lies A Bend In The Trail.

2407.description:
The tunnel burrows through the hill in a long straight line, its walls
hung with roots and glistening with damp. The dark is complete a few
paces in, and your own footsteps seem to follow you rather than lead. A
smell of turned earth and stale water lies thick in the air. The tunnel
leads north to a hillside, and south back to the bend in the trail.

2408.name: A Rocky Bend In The Trail

south.description: To the south lies A Small Crowded Clearing.

west.description: To the west lies A Deep, Dark Cave.

2408.description:
The trail breaks out of the trees onto a ledge of broken grey rock where
the hill shoulders up from the forest. Lichen has made yellow maps of
the boulders, and the wind comes in slow, sighing gusts. Far below, the
canopy rolls away in a green sea. To the west a gap in the hillside
opens on a deep, dark cave, and the clearing lies south.

2409.name: A Deep, Dark Cave

east.description: To the east lies A Rocky Bend In The Trail.

2409.description:
A huge cavern opens out of the hill, so deep that the entrance is only a
pale coin behind you. The air is thick and warm, and the very dark seems
to move like slow water. Mounds of shed scale, as large as roof tiles,
lie scattered across a floor of cracked stone. A vast, slow rumble
shakes the dust from the roof at long intervals. The only way out is the
opening to the east.

2410.name: A Sharp Curve In The Path

north.description: To the north lies Another Bend In The Trail.

east.description: To the east lies Entrance To The Hills.

2410.description:
The path takes a sharp curve around the shoulder of a hill, where wiry
grass bends before a wind that never quite arrives. Outcrops of grey
stone stand like sleeping beasts among the heather. The trail ahead
rises to the north, while the entrance to the hills lies east. Your
shadow seems to lag behind you on the turf.

2411.name: Entrance To The Hills

south.description: To the south lies The Dark Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Sharp Curve In The Path.

2411.description:
You come out of the tunnel onto a bare green slope, where the hills rise
in gentle folds under a pale, low sky. A cairn of white stones marks the
entrance, and the wind brings the sound of the sea a little late. Sheep
tracks wind off across the turf. The path continues west along the
hillside, and the tunnel mouth lies south.

2412.name: Another Bend In The Trail

east.description: To the east lies Before The Summit.

south.description: To the south lies A Sharp Curve In The Path.

2412.description:
The ground steepens and turns to stony scree, with gorse clinging in the
hollows and the sky growing wide and bright above. Each stone you kick
rolls a slow, long way before it stops. A weathered post leans by the
path, its carved marks worn to nothing. The trail goes east toward the
summit, and south back down the hillside.

2413.name: Before The Summit

north.description: To the north lies The Final Plateau.

west.description: To the west lies Another Bend In The Trail.

2413.description:
A last steep rise of bare rock lies here below the summit, scarred by
weather and stained orange with lichen. The wind sings thin and slow
over the stone, and the sound arrives well after the gust that made it.
Below, the whole island lies spread out in the haze, the forest dark and
the beach a pale thread. The path climbs north to the plateau and falls
west toward the bend you left.

2414.name: Entrance Into The Caves

east.description: To the east lies A Curve In The Caves.

2414.description:
The cave mouth is a low arch of weathered rock, hung with fern and
dripping slowly into a pool the size of a hat. Daylight reaches only a
few paces inside, and then thickens like honey before giving way to
dark. Your voice comes back a breath too late. The cave leads on east
into the hill.

2415.name: A Curve In The Caves

north.description: To the north lies A Sharp Bend.

west.description: To the west lies Entrance Into The Caves.

2415.description:
The tunnel bends sharply here, its walls pressed smooth and glossy by a
long seep of water. A faint drip counts out a time that does not match
your pulse. The floor is damp clay printed with the old tracks of heavy
paws. The passage turns north toward a sharper bend, and west toward the
cave mouth.

2416.name: Another Curve

north.description: To the north lies A Narrow Twist.

east.description: To the east lies A Sharp Bend.

2416.description:
The cave twists again, narrowing to a crooked throat where rock teeth
hang from the roof and rise from the floor. The air is close and still,
and the dust you stir hangs in the dark far longer than it should. A
smear of old soot on the wall marks where some visitor turned back. The
passage goes north to a tight twist and east to the sharp bend.

2417.name: A Sharp Bend

south.description: To the south lies A Curve In The Caves.

west.description: To the west lies Another Curve.

2417.description:
At this sharp bend the roof of the cave drops so low that you must
stoop, and the rock wears a fur of pale moss. Footsteps seem to sound a
moment after your feet leave the ground. Scratched arrows, half healed
over by mineral crust, point in two directions at once. The tunnel runs
south to the curve you passed, and west on into the dark.

2418.name: A Narrow Twist

east.description: To the east lies The Final Bend.

south.description: To the south lies Another Curve.

2418.description:
The passage here is a narrow twist, barely wide enough for a man to
squeeze through with his pack held before him. The stone is clammy and
sweating, and a low slow rumbling carries along it from deeper in.
Sounds arrive here as if heard through water. The way goes east toward
the last bend, and south back to the curve you passed.

2419.name: The Final Bend

north.description: To the north lies The Cave Of Doom.

west.description: To the west lies A Narrow Twist.

2419.description:
The last bend opens the cave into a wider gallery where pale stalactites
hang like wax from a candle left burning for years. Every drip sounds
twice, the second time long after the first. A heavy musk drifts in from
the north, thick with old smoke and stranger things. The gallery narrows
back west toward the twist.

2420.name: The Cave Of Doom

south.description: To the south lies The Final Bend.

up.description: To the up lies A Cluttered Beach.

2420.description:
A great vault of black rock swallows the torchlight, its far end
invisible beyond hills of fallen stone. Heaps of bones and rotted
sailcloth lie where something dragged them in from the beach long ago.
Each sound arrives late, and each slow breath from the shadows rolls
round the walls like a tide. A rough chimney of rock climbs up toward a
gleam of daylight, and the gallery you left lies south.

2422.name: The Final Plateau

south.description: To the south lies Before The Summit.

2422.description:
The summit is a bare plateau of tilted rock, open to a sky that seems
too near and too still. A ring of standing stones, leaning like tired
watchers, circles a flat slab worn hollow by the weather. Clouds drift
across the sun as slowly as fallen leaves on a pond. The only way down
leads south along the trail you climbed.

extra_descs.stones ring standing slab:
The standing stones lean toward the slab at their centre, and the hollow
worn into it holds still, dark water that does not ripple in the wind.

649600.name: giant crab wreck
649600.long_desc: A giant wreck crab picks sluggishly through the flotsam, one great claw raised and waiting.
649600.description:
A crab as big as a washtub, its shell crusted with barnacles and old
rope. It moves with a slow, deliberate patience that makes it no less
dangerous.

649601.name: bear drowsy brown
649601.long_desc: A drowsy brown bear shambles through the trees, blinking at the world as though waking from a long dream.
649601.description:
A big brown bear with matted fur and half-lidded eyes. It moves as
though underwater, but its claws are sharp and quick when it chooses.

649602.name: bat giant cave lag
649602.long_desc: A giant cave bat hangs from the roof, its leathery wings folded and quivering.
649602.description:
A bat with a wingspan broader than a man's arms, its fur grey with cave
dust. Its cry reaches the ear a moment after its fangs.

649603.name: ghost mist drowned sailor
649603.long_desc: The ghost of a drowned sailor drifts here, trailing mist, reaching toward you in slow motion.
649603.description:
A pale, translucent shape in a salt-stained coat, water streaming
endlessly from its sleeves. Its hands reach out slowly, but the cold
they carry arrives all at once.

649604.name: troll cave tarry
649604.long_desc: A lumbering cave troll sways in the dark, its slow stare fixed on you.
649604.description:
A mottled grey troll with long arms and a face like a fist. It seems
half asleep until the moment it strikes, and then the blow comes too
fast to follow.

649605.name: gorrak ogre dozing
649605.long_desc: Gorrak the Dozing Ogre lies against a wall of the vault, one huge eye cracked open.
649605.description:
Gorrak is an ogre of vast girth, wrapped in sailcloth and snoring like a
gale. His eyelid lifts slowly, and the club beside him lifts slower
still, but when it falls the stone shakes.

649606.name: lag wyrm dragon
649606.long_desc: The Lag Wyrm lies coiled in the dark, vast and ancient, its slow breath moving the dust of ages.
649606.description:
A dragon of the oldest kind, its scales dull as river stone and its eyes
like twin slow lanterns. Everything about it is slow: the breath, the
blink, the turn of the great head. The doom it carries is not slow at
all.

749600.name: buckler crab shell
749600.room_desc: A crab shell buckler lies here.
749600.description: A round buckler made from the shell of a huge crab, barnacles and all. It is tough and a bit slippery.

749601.name: pendant sailor drowned silver
749601.description: A small silver anchor on a green chain, forever damp to the touch.

749602.name: belt troll hide
749602.description: A broad belt of grey hide, thick as a finger and tough as old rope.

749603.name: club ogre gorrak heavy
749603.room_desc: A heavy ogre's club lies here.
749603.description: A knotted trunk of ironwood, wrapped in ship's rope for a grip. It falls slowly but lands hard.

749604.name: fang wyrm dragon lag
749604.short_desc: a fang of the Lag Wyrm
749604.room_desc: A long yellowed fang lies here.
749604.description: A fang as long as a short sword, hollow-ground and edged along both sides. It feels heavy in the hand, as if time pooled in it.
